verdict.rationale: AMD documents software-level APIs (ONNX Runtime C++/Python APIs, Vitis AI EP, Lemonade SDK) for driving AI workloads on the NPU, but there is no public REST/OpenAPI-style programmatic interface for 'driving the product' as an agentic system — probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs all 404. missing for 10: a documented public REST/agent-facing API or SDK entry point beyond ML framework runtimes, independent confirmation of API usage for agentic control.
